name: Beyond Lithium Inc.
summary: Beyond Lithium Inc. is a Canadian firm engaged in the acquisition, advancement, and exploration of mineral properties, primarily targeting lithium deposits and other base metals. The company holds a complete 100% interest in the Eastchester-Fabie-Trudeau property, a collection of disconnected mining claims situated northwest of Rouyn-Noranda, Quebec. Its portfolio also includes the Peggy Group Lithium Property, encompassing 7,386 hectares of claims north of Sioux Lookout, Ontario, and the North Trout Lake Lithium Property, consisting of 3,490 contiguous hectares of claims near Sandy Lake, Ontario. Established in 2019, the company, formerly known as Beyond Minerals Inc., adopted its current name, Beyond Lithium Inc., in May 2023, and is headquartered in Winnipeg, Canada.
